entries.summary: Given a 2D integer array items, where each item is represented as [factori, pricei], and an integer budget, determine the maximum total number of item copies (both purchased and free) you can obtain.

entries.title: Exactly One Consecutive Set Bits Pair
entries.summary: Given an integer n, determine if its binary representation contains exactly one pair of consecutive set bits, and return true if so, otherwise return false.

entries.title: Sum of Compatible Numbers in Range I
entries.summary: Given integers n and k, find the sum of all positive integers x that meet the criteria: the absolute difference between n and x is less than or equal to k, and the bitwise AND of n and x equals zero.

entries.title: Valid Binary Strings With Cost Limit
entries.summary: Given integers n and k, find all binary strings of length n that do not have two consecutive '1's and whose indices sum to a cost no greater than k.

entries.title: Minimum Cost to Split into Ones II
entries.summary: Given an integer n, find the minimum total cost to split it into n ones using operations that split an integer x into two positive integers a and b with a cost of a * b for each split.

entries.title: Check Good Integer
entries.summary: Given a positive integer n, calculate the sum of its digits (digitSum) and the sum of the squares of its digits (squareSum).

entries.title: Frequency Balance Subarray
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums, identify the longest subarray where each element either appears a single time or in multiples that are either equal or double the frequency of another element within the subarray.

entries.title: Maximize Sum of Device Ratings
entries.summary: Given a 2D integer array units where each element represents the capacity of a unit in a device, the rating of a device is defined as the minimum capacity among all its units.

entries.title: Minimum Lights to Illuminate a Road
entries.summary: Given an array of integers representing positions on a road, where each position can have a working bulb or not, determine the minimum number of additional bulbs needed to ensure every position is illuminated by at least one bulb.

entries.title: Finish Time of Tasks I
entries.summary: Given n tasks forming a tree with task 0 as the root, and an array of base completion times, calculate the finish time for each task.

entries.title: Maximum Manhattan Distance After All Moves
entries.summary: Given a string of moves including 'U', 'D', 'L', 'R', and '_', where '_' can be replaced by any of these, determine the greatest Manhattan distance from the origin (0,0) achievable after executing all moves.

entries.title: Valid Subarrays With Matching Sum Digits I
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer digit x, count the subarrays where the sum's first and last digits both equal x.

entries.title: Maximum Total Sum of K Selected Elements
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums and two integers k and mul, select exactly k elements from nums.

entries.title: Filter Occupied Intervals
entries.summary: Given a 2D integer array occupiedIntervals, where each element is a time interval [starti, endi] indicating an occupied period, merge any overlapping or touching intervals.

entries.title: Maximum Subarray Sum After Multiplier
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, you must select exactly one subarray and perform either of the following operations: - Multiply each element in the chosen subarray by k.

entries.title: Unique Middle Element
entries.summary: Given an integer array of odd length, determine if the middle element is unique by appearing exactly once.

entries.title: Maximum Valid Pair Sum
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, find the maximum sum of nums[i] + nums[j] for all valid pairs (i, j) where 0 = k.

entries.title: Sum of Integers with Maximum Digit Range
entries.summary: Given an integer array, calculate the digit range for each number as the difference between its largest and smallest digits.

entries.title: Number of Elapsed Seconds Between Two Times
entries.summary: Given two valid times in 'HH:MM:SS' format as startTime and endTime, calculate the total number of seconds that have passed between these two times.

entries.title: Minimum Total Cost to Process All Elements
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, you start with k resources.

entries.title: Sort Array Using Prefix Reversals
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums that is a permutation of the integers in the range [0, n-1] and an array pre containing valid prefix lengths, determine the minimum number of operations required to sort nums in ascending order by performing prefix reversals.

entries.title: Maximum Value of an Alternating Sequence
entries.summary: Given integers n, s, and m, find the largest possible value in a valid alternating sequence of length n starting with s, where the absolute difference between consecutive elements does not exceed m.

entries.title: Even Number of Knight Moves
entries.summary: Given two cell coordinates on an 8x8 chessboard, determine if a knight can reach the target in an even number of moves.

entries.title: Largest Integer With Given Digit Sum
entries.summary: Given non-negative integers n and s, find the largest integer with at most n digits and a digit sum of s.

entries.title: Aggregate Two Time Series
entries.summary: Given two 2D integer arrays, each containing [timestamp, value] pairs sorted in increasing timestamp order, create an aggregated series by summing corresponding values at each timestamp.

entries.title: Count Valid Sequences
entries.summary: Given positive integers n and k, find the count of sequences of k positive integers where the sum equals n and the product is even.

entries.title: Count Valid Prefixes
entries.summary: Given a binary string, count the number of prefixes that can be rearranged to form an alternating string where no two adjacent characters are the same.

entries.title: Minimum Initial Strength to Defeat All Monsters
entries.summary: Given an integer array monsters, where each element represents the strength of a monster, and a 2D integer array boosts, where each element is a triplet [li, ri, vi] indicating that a temporary bonus of vi is available while fighting any monster whose index is between li and ri (inclusive), calculate the minimum initial strength required to defeat all the monsters.

entries.title: Maximize Pair Strength Using GCD
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums, select a unique pair of distinct indices i and j.

entries.title: Count Subarrays With Even Odd Ratio I
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums and two integers a and b, count the number of subarrays where the ratio of even elements to odd elements is less than or equal to a/b, with the condition that there must be at least one odd element in the subarray.

entries.title: Count of Unfinished Tasks After Each Shift
entries.summary: Given two arrays, tasks and shifts, where tasks[i] is the time to complete the i-th task and shifts[j] is the time available during the j-th shift, process tasks in order.

entries.title: Minimum Total Price After Applying Discounts
entries.summary: Given integer arrays prices and discounts, where prices[i] is the price of the i-th item and discounts[j] is a discount percentage, determine the minimum total price after applying at most one discount to each item.

entries.title: Elevator Requests I
entries.summary: Given an integer n for the number of floors and an integer array requests, an elevator starts at floor 0 and moves one floor per second.

entries.title: Minimum Operations to Make a Rotated Palindrome I
entries.summary: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters, you can perform the following operations any number of times (including zero) and in any order: - Increment: Choose any index i and replace s[i] with the next lowercase English letter.

entries.title: K-th Digit in Infinite String
entries.summary: Given an integer k, construct an infinite string by concatenating the decimal representations of positive integers in a specific order.

entries.title: Nearest Available Drone
entries.summary: Given a list of drones with their coordinates and ranges, and a target coordinate, find the index of the nearest drone that can reach the target.

entries.title: Minimize the Maximum Waiting Time at Synchronized Traffic Lights
entries.summary: Given an integer period and an array lights, where lights[i] represents the duration of the green phase for the i-th traffic light, and an array arrivalTime indicating the arrival time of each car, assign each car to exactly one traffic light.

entries.title: Maximum Gap Between Stations
entries.summary: Given two strings, skill and station, each of length n and m respectively, assign each worker to a unique station such that skill[i] matches station[j] for all i, and the station indices assigned to the workers must be strictly increasing.

entries.title: Check ASCII Palindromic
entries.summary: Given a string of lowercase English letters, convert each character to its 8-bit binary ASCII representation, maintaining the order.

entries.title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array II
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums and a range [lower, upper], identify all integers within this range that are missing from nums.

entries.title: Minimum Bishop Moves to Reach Target
entries.summary: Given an 8x8 chessboard with 1-indexed rows and columns, a bishop starts at a specified position and aims to reach a target position.

entries.title: Maximum Valid Split Positions I
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums, you can remove at most one element.

entries.title: Lexicographically Largest String After Pair Transformations
entries.summary: Given an integer array nums, for each integer x in nums, start with a string consisting of exactly x lowercase 'a' characters.

entries.title: Count Integers Appearing in a Single Block
entries.summary: Given an integer array, count the number of unique integers that appear consecutively without interruption.

entries.title: Count Rotations With Exactly K Equal Adjacent Pairs
entries.summary: Given a string s of length n and an integer k , count the number of cyclic rotations of s such that the score of each rotation equals k .

entries.title: Count Good Cyclic Rotations
entries.summary: Given an even-length integer array, count the number of cyclic rotations where the sum of the first half of the array is strictly greater than the sum of the second half.
